evidence.whole_runs_condition: CPU and GPU twin run side by side, three pairs one after another, machine otherwise idle; file RUN_COMPARISON.json
evidence.tests: 55 passed including GPU and APECSS tests (TESTS.log)

limits: For one cluster per call (32-128 points) the GPU field is not faster: whole runs took 1.2-1.4x longer. The kernel run (~0.4 ms) dominates a small call and the laptop GPU clocks down while the CPU does the rest of the step; in-run GPU call times varied strongly between repeats.
The GPU pays off from about 128 points per call (13x at 1024, 40x at 16,384 points), i.e. when many trajectories are evaluated in one call; a batch runner does not exist yet.
Runs with the default field need Warp and a CUDA device; CPU-only machines must set field to "direct" or "cache".
